title: Workers
sub: People who offer farm work in the Jutyar app: their name, phone and cost. Farmers browse the cards and call. Staff can remove a card.
sample_note: Sample data: no staff token is set, so these workers are examples kept in this browser. Set VITE_STAFF_TOKEN to load the real cards from the server.
live_note: Live data from the server. Removing a card here removes it from the app.
load_failed: The workers could not be loaded from the server ({code}). Check the staff token and its farmers:read permission.
search: Name or the work they do
name: Name
remove_text: The worker's card is removed and farmers no longer see it. The worker can put up a new card from the app. This cannot be undone.
remove_failed: The card could not be removed ({code}).
